<!-- ABOUTME: Help documentation for the WaveSpeed Preview Video ComfyUI node. -->
<!-- ABOUTME: Downloads and previews videos generated by WaveSpeed AI. -->

# WaveSpeed Preview Video

Downloads a video from a URL and saves it to the ComfyUI output directory. Displays the video inline in the workflow.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| video_url | String | -- | URL of the video to preview and save |
| save_file_prefix | String | "wavespeed_video" | Prefix for the saved video filename |

## Output

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| file_path | String | Local file path where the video was saved |

## Notes

- Saved files include a timestamp to avoid overwrites
- Defaults to `.mp4` extension if the URL doesn't contain a recognizable video extension
- This is an output node -- it can terminate a workflow branch
